description: This file declares functions and macros related to file system operations, such as checking file existence, opening, reading, and writing files, as well as string manipulation to remove file extensions.

methods.name: lu5_name_without_extention
methods.description: Returns a new allocated string with the filename without its extension.

methods.name: lu5_open_file
methods.description: Opens a file with error handling, imported from WASM environment.

methods.name: lu5_write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a file, imported from WASM environment.

methods.name: lu5_read_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file, caller must free the returned buffer, imported from WASM environment.
